Actual wall corner and five licensed OGG variants

Art/source delivery for BL-076. The wall is an authored opaque PNG, placed in a separate native Tiled map with two movement footprints. Canonical map/default and runtime sight remain unchanged. Audio files are original Kenney / ianzazz CC0 recordings, not synthesized warning placeholders.

Placement origin (896,64). Vertical ground rectangle (904,112,16,128); horizontal (904,112,144,8). Physical feet/cap are distinct from the artwork's raised wall face. Source map schema1 validates movement; its blocks_sight authoring properties await the integration owner's explicit sight schema.
